newsitem.title: ITALY: Ciampi signs two Italy pension fund managing rules.
newsitem.headline: Ciampi signs two Italy pension fund managing rules.

text.p: Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi signed two regulations fleshing out a broad framework for management of private pension funds, the Treasury confirmed in a statement.
The first regulation states criteria and the methods which companies must observe in managing the resources entrusted to them by pension funds, the Treasury said.
The second defines the financial activities in which the funds can invest and fixes investment limits and the rules in cases of conflict of interest.
The Labour Ministry still has to issue further regulations before funds can start operating.

Reforms to the Italian pension sector last year removed obstacles to the launch of private pension funds and the government has been working on measures to provide a regulatory framework for their management.
Many trade unions, foreign companies, banks and insurance groups have expressed interest in entering the market.
